name: Granny Puddingfoot
blurb: A hen of means. Grows berries out of spite for the neighbour's roses.

name: Unit B-3RRY
blurb: A gardening robot with a small berry surplus and a large vocabulary.

name: Sir Nibbleton
blurb: A seagull knight. Has sworn off chips. Strawberries are fine.

name: Baker Bun
blurb: A bunny pastry chef. Every tart needs exactly one more strawberry.

name: Captain Barnacle
blurb: Retired crab pirate. Treasure is treasure, even if it's just shells.

name: Shelly
blurb: A sea otter who keeps her favourite shell in her pocket. The rest are for sale.

name: Madame Coquille
blurb: A snail couturier. Her new line is 'shells, but on hats'.

name: Pip the Beachcomber
blurb: A hermit crab forever shopping for a slightly bigger home.

name: Vinyl Vince
blurb: A raccoon who 'found' a crate of records. Please do not ask where.

name: Grandpa Gramophone
blurb: A tortoise clearing out ninety years of records, one slow sale at a time.

name: Gloop
blurb: A tourist from beyond the stars, collecting 'Earth music discs'.

name: DJ Mothball
blurb: A moth who spins records under the one streetlamp that matters.

name: Walter the Walrus
blurb: A retired sailor who weaves straw hats on the dock. Has more hats than heads.

name: Mrs. Tinkerbottom
blurb: A mouse milliner. Tinkers with a new brim every morning and forgets why by noon.

name: Bramble the Beaver
blurb: A carpenter beaver. Chews through a hat brim a week, somehow.

name: Gnorman the Gnome
blurb: A garden gnome. Would like a hat that isn't pointy, just once.

name: Mama Mugsworth
blurb: A bear with a cocoa cart. Brews in a pot big enough to hibernate in. Has tried.

name: Flurry
blurb: A snowman who sells hot cocoa at arm's length. Business is booming. He is not.

name: Bernard
blurb: A rescue dog. The barrel is for emergencies, and every day is an emergency.

name: Dozy
blurb: A dormouse refusing to hibernate out of pure stubbornness. Runs on cocoa.

name: Mortimer Mole
blurb: Digs for worms and keeps hitting crystals. He's very disappointed.

name: Pebble
blurb: A tiny cave golem. Crystals grow on him like moss; he's glad someone wants them.

name: Smoulder
blurb: A baby dragon starting a hoard on a budget. Crystals are cheaper than gold.

name: Madame Glimmer
blurb: An arctic fox fortune teller. Keeps cracking crystal balls. She foresaw you'd come.

name: Herr Kuckuck
blurb: A cuckoo clockmaker. His music boxes are the clocks that failed their exams.

name: Lady Lullaby
blurb: The lodge ghost. Has wound the same music boxes every midnight since 1893.

name: Pirouette
blurb: An ermine ballerina. Dances only to tiny tunes, and wears them out.

name: Yuki
blurb: A shy yeti who can't sleep without a lullaby. Hugs a little too hard.

name: Brunhilde
blurb: A badger knitter. Her mittens are so thick only she can bend the thumbs.

name: Tollbert
blurb: A bridge troll. Charges one mitten to cross. Now has far too many, and none match.

name: Foreman Marmaduke
blurb: A marmot mine boss. His crew loses a mitten in every snowdrift.

name: Scramble
blurb: A mountain goat ice-climber. Goes up in two mittens, eats one on the way down.

name: Mister Kaiten
blurb: A sushi conveyor belt that learned to talk. Everything he says comes back around eventually.

name: Chef Omakase
blurb: Has run the same eight-seat counter for forty years. He chooses your sushi. He also chooses your seat.

name: Kyu the Kappa
blurb: Only eats cucumber rolls. They're called kappa maki after him, and he will mention it.

name: Hachi
blurb: Meets the last train at Midnight Station every night, with a sushi roll for whoever gets off.

name: Gacha-chan
blurb: Turn his crank and out pops a capsule. What's inside is between him and the crank.

name: Mochi
blurb: Poses as a lucky cat in shop windows. Hands out capsules to anyone who stops to look.

name: Karasu
blurb: Has missed the last train again. Collects capsule toys for his desk; the whole set is just one more turn away.

name: Kirara
blurb: Keeps a capsule toy from every concert. She has had a lot of concerts.

name: Goro
blurb: Drums up the summer storms and sells last season's drums. Accepts belly buttons as a tip.

name: Kabuto
blurb: Carves every drum from a single log, mostly with his horn.

name: Kenji the Kaiju
blurb: In from the bay for the night. Keeps trying to play the drums gently. Keeps flattening them.

name: Ponpoko
blurb: Has drummed on his own belly for years. Would like to try something that doesn't hurt.

name: Old Chochin
blurb: A paper lantern that came to life on its hundredth birthday. Keeps the stall lit so you can see the patterns.

name: Orika
blurb: Weaves cloth behind a closed door. Please don't peek.

name: Tsuki
blurb: Comes down for moon viewing at Stargazer's Lookout. Wants something nice to wear for it.

name: Taisho
blurb: Closes the izakaya once a year for the fireworks, and wants to look sharp.
